more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.overview: Anoxomer is a synthetic polymeric antioxidant made by joining several phenolic starting materials with divinylbenzene. The resulting ingredient is a mixture of large molecules, with limits on low-molecular-weight components and residual starting materials. It protects food from oxidative deterioration. The US regulation specifically describes antioxidant use in foods, with the amount related to the fat and oil content.
